author: aKidWolfe
name: ChatterboxTTS
short: Speak messages in voice chat with a self-hosted Chatterbox TTS server.
description: Sends text to your own Chatterbox TTS server and plays it in a voice channel, always in your voice.wav voice. If Red's Audio cog is playing music, it steps aside for the message and then puts the music back where it was: same song, position, queue and volume.
install_msg: Point the cog at your Chatterbox server with `[p]ttsset url http://HOST:PORT` (check it with `[p]ttsset status`), then use `[p]tts <message>` while in a voice channel. The cog always speaks with voice.wav from the server's voices folder. The bot host needs ffmpeg installed. Docker setup scripts for the server are in the repo under chatterbox_tts/docker (chatterbox-docker.cmd on Windows, chatterbox-docker.sh on Linux).
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any data about users.
